snippet.title: Salt and Soil — Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
▶ Wishlist now on Steam: https://bit.ly/3SG1Aeu

One family. Three hundred years. Every year, one decision.

Salt and Soil is a frontier colony sim where a single turn is a single year, and you guide one bloodline across 300 years of American history (1607–1907) — from a lone homestead in the wilderness to a dynasty that outlives everyone who founded it.

Think RimWorld's emergent storytelling meeting Crusader Kings' dynastic legacy, on the American frontier.

Made solo. Wishlisting genuinely helps a one-person studio reach release — thank you for watching.

#indiegame #colonysim #strategygame #simulation #pixelart #indiedev #wishlist #frontier #basebuilding #pcgaming 

For fans of: colony sim, simulation games, strategy games, base building, survival, dynasty, frontier / pioneer / homestead, story generator, RimWorld-like, Crusader Kings-like, Oregon Trail, indie games 2026.
